text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you for the time off. I had a 
relaxing time back home."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I want to say "I'm home" to my family, 
help with chores, eat meals, go out... and 
just relax.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Having a place to return to brings peace 
to the heart... and gives you strength. I 
was reminded of that once again. ...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"—I'm back, Trainer. Let's do our best 
together once again."

Furioso came back completely recharged and 
full of energy!
